subject: Carnatic Music (Percussion Instruments)

source.title: Carnatic Music (Percussion Instruments), Code 033, Classes XI-XII (2026-27)

internalBreakdown.component: Internal assessment: project file 5, project work 5, periodic practical tests 10

notes: Theory 30 marks (2 hours) without a unit-wise split; practical 50 (external examiner); internal assessment 20.

units.name: Theory: History and Theory of Indian Music

chapters.name: Lakshana Granthas (Class XI)
topics: Natya Sastra, Brihaddesi, Sangita Sampradaya Pradarshini with reference to laya and percussion

chapters.name: Composers and Luminaries (Class XI)
topics: Patnam Subramanya Iyer, Syama Sastri, Tyagaraja
Narayanaswamy Appa, Mamundiya Pillai, Dakshinamurti Pillai, Alagunambi Pillai

chapters.name: Terms (Class XI)
topics: Nada, laya, tala, jati, gati, suladi sapta talas, karani, vettu, thattu, hechchu, taggu, mohra, korvai, meettu, chapu, arachapu

chapters.name: Korvai Notation and Instruments (Class XI)
topics: Notation of korvais in Adi and Rupaka
Construction of the chosen instrument; mridangam technique; kanjira, tavil, ghatam

chapters.name: Tattakarams (Class XI)
topics: Tattakarams or konnakkol of the talas learnt

chapters.name: Talas with Elaboration (Class XI)
topics: Adi and Rupaka talas in at least two nadais

chapters.name: Thekas, Mohras and Sollukattus (Class XI)
topics: Thekas and mohras with teermanam and korvais
